title: Additional 2.5m height (15m to 17.5m) when stilt parking is provided, clause (iv)

citations.original_text: Maximum height of the building shall be 15m ... In plots with stilt parking height of the building shall be upto 17.5m (i.e. stilt + 4 habitable floors).

notes: Bonus derived as difference between 17.5m (with stilt) and 15m (without stilt); page states absolute heights, not the bonus explicitly. Verify.
